text_block_list.text:
With her long-awaited debut race upon her, 
King Halo laughed triumphantly, declaring, 
"I'll be the very first to make my debut!"

"...Meanwhile, from the TV in the waiting 
room, praise could be heard for Grass 
Wonder's splendid debut run from the other 
day."

King Halo missed out on making her debut 
first. ...Well, all's well that ends well. 
Time to step up for her debut race!!
